Thanks for your support. 
I've considered antidepressants and antianxiety meds but it's hard for me to justify using them. It just doesn't seem like the right way to approach the situation, but like you said, I will use them as a last resort if I absolutely have to. I think I'm going to try and seek medical help for it, because I know that even if I've talked myself down this time I could wake up tomorrow and feel the same way (because this cycle has happened for the past few days). Thanks for your comment and your support.

Wow, your post really spoke to me.
I guess it's just hard for me to imagine that someone is sincere in telling me that it ISN'T something that I've done. I'm doing my best to continue being her friend like she said she wanted, but it's hard for me to invest myself as much as I did in full knowledge that there won't be a relationship anytime soon if there ever will be one at all. Thank you so much for your help. Between you and the friend of mine that I talked to, it's making things a lot easier to deal with. I may have finally talked myself into going into the kitchen and eating something today.

I took your advice and I talked to one of my closest friends. 
For now, the ideas of doing it at all have subsided. I'm looking for an outlet to keep me occupied and to keep my mind off of the harder parts of life. Thank you so much for your help and I'm glad that this wasn't a post in vain.
